description: Add a dependency between tasks. Requires task + exactly one of: depends_on (task is blocked by another) or dependency_of (task is blocking another). Supports name or ID for all tasks.

dependency_of.description: Task name or ID that depends on 'task' (i.e., task is blocking this). Provide this OR depends_on, not both.

dependency_of_list.description: List name for resolving dependency_of task by name.

depends_on.description: Task name or ID that 'task' depends on (i.e., task is blocked by this). Provide this OR dependency_of, not both.

depends_on_list.description: List name for resolving depends_on task by name.

listName.description: List name for resolving task by name.

task.description: Task name or ID to set the dependency on. REQUIRED.

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: add_task_dependency
